# Colony History
[italic]A short history of Shivas' Snowball for new arrivals, as the Herald's archive tells it.[/italic]
## The Probe In 2082 an Argentinian deep space probe passed LV-343 and sent home chemical traces that something had once lived here. The scientists' best guess is that the planet was temperate until an ice age closed over it around 98,000 years ago. An expedition was drawn up, argued over and shelved for want of money.
## The Long Wait It took thirty-four years. In 2116, with the young United Americas looking to projects nearer the Core Systems, the old Argentinian plan was finally approved, and Weyland-Yutani signed on as its main backer. Four years of orbital and ground surveys followed before a safe landing site was confirmed.
## Landing - The first colonists came down in 2120, as soon as the site was cleared. - The colony was assembled from cheap prefabricated sections, the MegaStruct blocks that still form the heart of the settlement, and it was fully operational by 2122. - The Herald started that same year as a single typed sheet pinned up in the mess, so the drill crews could find out what the survey office was not telling them.
## The Spiders Something stowed away on the first ship. Its descendants found LV-343's thin air and rich oxygen very much to their liking, and they have grown far larger than anything their ancestors could manage on Earth. They nest in the caves and the dark corners of the old habs, and year on year they cost the colony equipment, time and, now and then, a life.
## Company Security The colony could not keep the spiders back on its own, so it contracted Weyland-Yutani to protect its staff. A Company liaison now sits between the security teams and the research directors. The Herald has asked more than once who that liaison actually answers to. We are still waiting for a straight reply.
## The Work Today Researchers drill cores out of the ice sheets and study them in the labs for any trace of ancient microbial life. Some of that work still runs out of the Argentinian Research Headquarters by the second landing field. Nobody has announced a find yet. When somebody does, we intend to be the first to ask who owns it.
